mode: fixture set staged around the built bundle; the Pi half is the installed pi-1.6.0 artifact; the model half is the local fake provider (fake-provider success, not real-provider); the --store route is measured end to end against a store registered with `openspec store setup` into this run's isolated HOME (d-verify3 C-1; the d-verify2 G-2 limitation is closed)
unpinned-close-notice: the Decision 14 notice (a verification that closed with no target pinned says so once, and how to reopen it) is unit-covered, not measured here: every stage of this run either names its change on the opening line or replaces the step before it closes, so no un-pinned close happens. Cases: packages/spirits/test/verify-report-nudge.test.ts 'a deep verification that settles asking which change says no report was saved', 'a physical model session that answers an un-named verification is told once', 'the un-pinned close goes to stderr in stdout modes and stays silent on an abort' (print and json), plus the d-verify3 C-1 boundary that the close consumes its obligation: 'an aborted pinned deep verification is not announced by a later input', 'leaving a pinned verification through another command announces nothing later', 'a session start or tree move drops the window without the notice'
io-failure-regressions: d-verify3 C-2's two failure injections are unit regressions, not RPC measurements: packages/spirits/test/verify-report-save.test.ts cases 'a directory gone before the numbering is a reason, not an exception', 'a write that fails after the temporary file exists removes the temporary file', and 'the saver turns a post-resolution I/O failure into a reason'
run-judgement-definition: a run exists per before_agent_start the probe records; a provider request carrying the nudge message is the one continuation the settle bought; the saved files are read from the staged work directory's openspec/changes/alpha/{verify1,verify2}.md, and openspec/changes/beta/ must hold no report after the move-attempt input
host-facts-observed: at every quiet settle the event context reports canContinue=false (it is computed before boundary drafts, with the assistant message last); the host re-checks continuation after committing the drafts, and the nudge custom_message reaches the wire as the newest user turn; the session runs on the spirits/auto routing model because a physical-model session ends an unresolved step at the next idle input (routing rule), which is outside this change
